set.body: atlas JVM: MniTemplateBridgeFilesSuite 'a qualified numerical inverse gives the forward map and an executable reverse route' fails with OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space inside reframe4s NumericalInversion when the sbt-warm server (3 GB heap) has already run other module tests; passes 8/8 (and atlas 116/116) in a fresh server. Seen twice on 2026-10-04 (reconcile gate at 7180694a; C8 gate at 07e239c1). Investigate the allocation in NumericalInversion (reframe4s pin 5f7152aa) / fixture size, or fork tests for atlasJVM; until then run it first or alone. Risk: flaky CI if the runner heap is tight.
set.title: MniTemplateBridgeFilesSuite OOMs in a warm sbt server (reframe4s NumericalInversion)
